reuse.why: Reuses the existing unlinkAccount action to detach the previous holder and the existing ensureAccountIsOpen/linked-account query, folding them into one prepareBankAccountLink.

duplication.why: Removes the two-call guard repeated in six handler registrations and does not copy the unlink field-clearing.

placement.why: The guard stays in accounts/app.ts at the handler-registration layer where the existing link checks were applied.

scope.why: Only the link parameter type, the guard, unlinkAccount's provider-call opt-out, the six registrations and tests change.

maintainability.why: One entry point now decides closed, duplicate and takeover rules for every provider; the new early return in unlinkAccount returns 'ok' where the neighbouring path returns undefined, a small inconsistency.
